title: Mark T NDE 3733
content: I was swimming in the sea at a beach in St. Tropez with my brother. I swam out to get my brother, who was snorkeling at the time, to tell him it was time to get out. By the time I had reached him, I was very tired and turned to swim back in again. I started to really struggle and came to a point where it was impossible for me to swim any more. I tried to stand but the water was too deep. I attempted to stay above water but this just resulted in me inhaling a lot of seawater. At this point, I was extremely frightened, panicked, and struggling. As I started to sink to the bottom, I felt myself being held and lowered to the seabed. Suddenly everything went white. There wasn't a tunnel, music, or anything like that, just a blanket of white light. The white light was as if you were to look directly at the sun. I felt as if I was gently laid down on the seabed. Then I felt surrounded in an invisible cloak of safety and serenity. It was the most peaceful feeling I had ever, and have had to this day, felt. I knew I was safe. Then I felt a horrible jolt as someone grabbed my arm. All of a sudden, the water felt extremely cold and I started to feel the same original panic as I felt the cloak slipping off me. A woman pulled me out of the water and I started breathing again. I was really annoyed at the woman, as if she had just woken me from a peaceful sleep - only ten times worse. I have no idea how long I had stopped breathing for or how long I had been under the water. My mum told me that she couldn't see me in the water for fifteen minutes before hand, but I don't know if that was just because she couldn't see me or because I was under the water. When I left the water, I felt cold and I was shaking but I was still thinking about everything that happened under the water.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt a 'horrible jolt' as someone grabbed his arm; a woman pulled him out of the water and he started breathing again.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning while swimming in the sea.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Felt 'being held and lowered to the seabed' and then 'surrounded in an invisible cloak of safety and serenity.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE or tunnel reported; experience centered on sudden white light and peaceful serenity, followed by abrupt return when pulled from the water.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Felt 'being held and lowered to the seabed' and 'gently laid down on the seabed' while everything turned into a 'blanket of white light'; described an 'invisible cloak of safety and serenity' that seemed to slip off on return.

There wasn't a tunnel, music, or anything like that, just a blanket of white light.”; “Then I felt surrounded in an invisible cloak of safety and serenity.”; “I was really annoyed at the woman, as if she had just woken me from a peaceful sleep.”
